name: Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®

apr.notes: The variable APR for purchases and balance transfers is 19.49% – 29.49%, based on your creditworthiness. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Cash advance fee – either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee – either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases (standard earn rate for non-bonus categories)

categories.label: Rides and Rails (taxis, rideshares, public transit)

rewards.redemption_notes: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage® mile earned from purchases to reach AAdvantage® status faster.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles and premium travel benefits. Bonus miles earned after $4,000 in purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: American Airlines Admirals Club® Lounge Access
benefits.description: Every calendar year, receive four Admirals Club® Globe™ Passes and enjoy access to nearly 50 Admirals Club® lounges (over $300 in value).

benefits.title: Up to $100 Annual Splurge Credit℠
benefits.description: Every calendar year, earn up to $100 in statement credits on your choice of up to two of the following brands: 1stDibs, eligible AAdvantage Hotels™ bookings, Future Personal Training and Live Nation® (exclusions apply).

benefits.title: Up to $240 back on Turo
benefits.description: Earn up to $30 in statement credits for each eligible Turo trip completed, for a total of up to $240 in statement credits annually. To qualify, you must link your card to your Turo account on Turo.com/Globe and pay for the trip with your card.

benefits.title: Up to $100 back on inflight purchases
benefits.description: Every calendar year, earn up to $100 in statement credits on inflight purchases when you use your card on American Airlines flights.

benefits.title: American Airlines Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Earn an American Airlines Companion Certificate starting in your second cardmembership year as long as your cardmembership is renewed. Companion certificate is good for a qualifying single round-trip main cabin domestic flight. Redeeming the certificate costs $99 for the ticketing fee, plus taxes and fees based on the itinerary.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to eight companions traveling with you on the same reservation, a savings of up to $900 per round trip.

benefits.title: Preferred boarding
benefits.description: Enjoy preferred boarding on American Airlines flights for you and up to eight companions traveling with you on the same reservation.

benefits.title: Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit
benefits.description: You're eligible to receive a statement credit (up to $120 every 4 years) as reimbursement for your Global Entry® or TSA PreCheck® application fee.

benefits.title: Travel protection benefits
benefits.description: Help protect your next trip with Enhanced Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption, Lost or Damaged Luggage, MasterRental® Coverage (Car Rental), Trip Delay, Extended Warranty and Purchase Assurance Plus.

benefits.title: Flight Streak™ bonus
benefits.description: Earn a 5,000 Loyalty Point bonus after every four qualifying American Airlines flights (up to 15,000 additional Loyalty Points each status qualification year).

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Shop like a local wherever your travels take you.

benefits.title: Add authorized users
benefits.description: Earn more AAdvantage® miles with purchases made by authorized user cards added to your account at no additional charge.

lounge_access.notes: 4 Admirals Club® Globe™ Passes per calendar year for access to nearly 50 Admirals Club® lounges (over $300 in value)

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 8 companions (savings up to $900 per round trip)
